name: Deliver Thomas' Report
summary: In eastern Elwynn, Guard Thomas sends word of two dead guards and rising danger. He asks you to carry the report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, where the garrison has few hands to spare.

sections.title: Bad Tidings from the East
sections.body: Guard Thomas watches the bridges into eastern Elwynn, where river traffic meets the wilderness. Guards Malakai and Rolf have been killed by aggressive murloc tribes. With his remaining guards too few to contain them, Thomas sends you down the road to Goldshire with an urgent report.

sections.title: A Garrison Stretched to the Brink
sections.body: Marshal Dughan receives Thomas' report in Goldshire, already struggling to keep patrols on the roads. Kobolds infest the area, Defias bandits threaten travelers, and Stormwind City has sent no reinforcements. The deaths of two experienced guards add to his burden. Murlocs may soon threaten Goldshire itself, while the defenses across the region grow ever thinner.

faq.answer: Malakai and Rolf were Stormwind guards stationed in eastern Elwynn under Guard Thomas. Murloc tribes overwhelmed and killed them while they patrolled near the rivers and lakes.

faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas asking an adventurer to deliver the report?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas has too few troops to spare. If he leaves his post or sends one of his few surviving sentries, the eastern bridges will be left undefended.

faq.q: What threat do the murlocs pose to Goldshire?
faq.answer: The murloc tribes along the eastern rivers are spreading west. Marshal Dughan fears they may reach Goldshire's outskirts within the week, and he has too few guards to hold the perimeter.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind City send reinforcements to Elwynn?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military resources are stretched across several fronts, and the disappearance of King Varian Wrynn has left the capital politically paralyzed. Outlying settlements and frontier bridges are largely left to local town watches and hired adventurers.

faq.q: What happens after Marshal Dughan reads the report?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan knows his garrison lacks the strength to stop the murlocs directly. He turns to securing supplies and armor for those willing to hold the line.
Guard Thomas is stationed in eastern Elwynn Forest, guarding the bridges over the rivers between the heart of the forest and the wilder borders near the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: Carrying Thomas' report shows how vulnerable the Alliance's central kingdom has become, with even roads outside the capital slipping from garrison control.
As a warrior serving the realm, you see the cost of frontier duty in the deaths of Malakai and Rolf, killed by relentless foes.
As a human, you feel these losses in your homeland, where too few defenders face more hostile incursions.
